title: Assessing the Reliability of LLMs Annotations in the Context of Demographic Bias and Model Explanation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the impact of annotator gender on the detection of sexist content by analyzing human annotations with a Generalized Linear Mixed Model (GLMM) and prompting LLMs with gender-specific personas.

Evaluating the impact of annotator ethnicity (e.g., Black, White, Latino) on the detection of sexist content by analyzing human annotations with a GLMM and prompting LLMs with ethnicity-specific personas.
Evaluating the impact of annotator age groups on the detection of sexist content by analyzing human annotations with a GLMM and prompting LLMs with age-specific personas.

Evaluating the impact of annotator education levels (e.g., High school, Bachelor's, Master's) on the detection of sexist content by analyzing human annotations with a GLMM and prompting LLMs with education-specific personas.

Evaluating the impact of annotator geographic region (e.g., Africa, America, Europe) on the detection of sexist content by analyzing human annotations with a GLMM and prompting LLMs with region-specific personas.
